top_choice_rationale: P001 is the optical lattice clock for Katori and Ye alone. The mechanism is simple and general: a magic-wavelength lattice cancels the clock-transition light shift, so many neutral atoms are interrogated Doppler- and recoil-free, which is distinct from the 2005 comb and 2012 single-ion control. It is independently reproduced at the 10^-18 level across national laboratories and used for redshift, constants and dark-matter tests. The two-name credit is compact, although the Tokyo versus JILA priority still needs the external expert reports. P002 adds Hosono's iron-based superconductors, a clean and verified discovery, but the pairing has no common thread and the pairing mechanism is still not understood, so I rank it second. A prize on the clock is better than no award.
